subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and what storage, validation, auth, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The feature is useful and aligned with web frontend ergonomics, but it crosses a new binary upload and workspace-write boundary that automation should not define without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves the existing avatar read protections.

options.title: Keep existing identity paths
options.body: Continue supporting manual CLI/config identity updates and browser-local overrides while avoiding a new server-side upload surface.

options.title: Defer core upload
options.body: Leave the request open or close it as out of scope until a broader Control UI identity-management design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves the existing avatar read protections.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the original avatar support merge and later Control UI avatar safety/refactor work.
